description: Use this when the signed-in owner gives you a photo of their business (their food, products, place or team) for Suara to use in their posts. Pass the photo uploaded in the chat, or a public https link to the image file. It goes into their photo library, where the Suara team picks photos for their posts; nothing is posted. The same photo twice is kept once.

note.description: What it shows or how to use it, optional, in the owner's words

photo.description: A photo uploaded in the chat

url.description: Or a public https link straight to the image file
